properties.displayName: [FedRAMP High] Key Vault: RBAC Authorization Required
properties.description: Denies deployment of Azure Key Vaults without RBAC authorization enabled. FedRAMP High requires access enforcement (AC-3) and least privilege (AC-6). RBAC authorization replaces legacy vault access policies with Entra ID role-based access control, enabling fine-grained permissions, PIM just-in-time activation, and centralized access auditing.

metadata.description: Deny: Block Key Vaults without RBAC authorization. Audit: Report non-compliance only. Disabled: Do not evaluate.
